HEEWON STYLE: Korean WEBTOON figures in watercolor-and-oil world, minimal iconic layout, movie tenebrism. Night ground BLACK. Thick ink line. Magenta #D8258C = real wet/lamp specular NOT glow. Composed for 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at top or bottom edge. No text. No watermark. Not photoreal. Painterly anime-adjacent cinema. HARD DUTCH low. SET: Tsushima strait, night storm. One Silla hull: cream sail, blue crescent. Black water, rain spears, lightning as the only hard white. Chunchu in soaking magenta. LAYOUT: Stake = vertical black divider. Chunchu BOUND (wrists tied), wet magenta. Chief crouches with coal on GREEN leafy wood; flame dies. Spearman + spiral shield in shadow right. Village thatch void. Faces ONLY from the attached sheet by position (LEFT to RIGHT as listed in the sheet). Invent new dramatic bodies — never portrait stance clones.
